{"edits": [{"finding_ids": ["app/profiles.py:8:optional-no-default", "app/profiles.py:9:optional-no-default", "app/profiles.py:10:optional-no-default", "app/profiles.py:15:test-failure"], "search": "    bio: Optional[str]
    website: Optional[str]
    age: Optional[int]", "replace": "    bio: Optional[str] = None
    website: Optional[str] = None
    age: Optional[int] = None", "explanation": "In Pydantic v2, a field annotated Optional[T] with no default is required (migration.md#required-optional-and-nullable-fields). Adding `= None` restores the v1 behavior where these fields default to None. This also fixes the test failure at line 15: profile_from_form omits blank form keys, so bio/website/age were missing and raised 'Field required'; with the None defaults they are populated as None, which is what test_blank_fields_become_none expects."}], "notes": "One edit covers lines 8-10 because they are adjacent and all need the same change. The test-failure finding (line 15) is resolved by the same change, since the failure is caused by the missing defaults; profile_from_form itself is unchanged. Only the three Optional fields were modified. The `interests: List[str] = []` line already has a default and needs no change. No deprecated v1 APIs appear in this file, so no other edits are needed. Imports are unchanged because Optional and List are still used."}
